fields.name: custom schema
fields.description: A custom metadata schema tailored to specific needs.

fields.name: ISO 19115
fields.description: An international standard for geographic information metadata.

fields.name: OGC SensorML
fields.description: A standard for describing sensors and sensor systems.

fields.name: OGC O&M
fields.description: Observations and Measurements (O&M) is a standard for encoding observations and measurements.

fields.name: INSPIRE EF
fields.description: The INSPIRE Environmental Monitoring Facilities (EF) data specification.

fields.name: WMO WIGOS
fields.description: A comprehensive metadata standard covering all types of observation is by nature complex to define. A user should be able to use the WIGOS metadata to identify the conditions under which the observation, or measurement, was made, and any aspects that may affect its use or understanding, that is, to determine whether the observations are fit for the purpose.

fields.name: EML
fields.description: Ecological Metadata Language (EML) is a metadata standard developed for the ecology discipline.

fields.name: schema.org
fields.description: A collaborative, community activity with a mission to create, maintain, and promote schemas for structured data on the Internet.

fields.name: FGDC
fields.description: Federal Geographic Data Committee (FGDC) is responsible for coordinating the development of the National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI).

fields.name: Other
fields.description: If none of the above standards apply, please select this option.
